subject: Novapointe: Engineering attendee / time windows for post-discovery session
messages:
From: Alicia Barnes <alicia@novapointe.io>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-08-24T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery technical session - who should we schedule with?

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for yesterday's discovery call — that was helpful. The internal stakeholders at Novapointe want to move to a focused technical review (network/firewall, auth/KMS, data residency) with an engineer from Redwood. Can you share who would be the best Redwood engineer to attend and a couple of time windows next week?

Our ideal attendees from our side would be Tom Hsu (infra lead) and our security architect — I'll confirm the security attendee once their calendar clears. We are in PDT.

Can you also attach a short agenda and any pre-read (especially expected network ports, sample token flow)? That will help our security lead decide whether to join live or just review notes.

Thanks,
Alicia Barnes
Director, Product Operations
Novapointe

--
Alicia Barnes
Alicia.Barnes@novapointe.io

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Barnes <alicia@novapointe.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24T17:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery technical session - who should we schedule with?

Hi Alicia — great to hear you're ready to move to an engineer-led review. Ben Carter (solutions engineering) and Marissa Cole (customer success / integration lead) can attend. Ben will lead the technical portion; Marissa will cover rollout and staging questions.

Proposed 60-minute windows (all PDT):
- Tue Aug 31, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Sep 1, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Sep 2, 08:00–09:00

Agenda (attached: novapointe-ops-agenda-draft.pdf):
1) 5m intro & goals
2) 20m architecture walk (model serving, routing, caching)
3) 15m network/firewall & KMS/auth patterns
4) 10m rollout matrix (staging, dedicated vs hosted options)
5) 10m open Q&A + next steps

High-level pre-reads: I've attached a short agenda and a network diagram (novapointe-network-diagram.png). Ben, can you confirm if we should request any additional logs or sample payloads from Novapointe ahead of time?

If none of those windows work, let me know two alternatives and we'll find a fit. Once Alicia confirms a slot, I'll send a calendar invite with a meeting link and a shared agenda document.

Thanks,
Priyom
Principal Pre-Sales
Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

(Attachment: novapointe-ops-agenda-draft.pdf, novapointe-network-diagram.png)

> Proposed 60-minute windows (all PDT):

> - Wed Sep 1, 14:00–15:00
> - Thu Sep 2, 08:00–09:00
>
> Agenda (attached) and network diagram attached.

I can cover the architecture and the KMS/auth flow. Quick note on pre-reads / ask for Novapointe:
- If you can share your ingress IP ranges or confirm use of proxy/NAT, that saves time on the firewall discussion.
- A small sample token exchange (obfuscated) or the auth flow diagram is useful — we don't need PII or keys.
- If your infra uses strict egress rules, let us know the allowed outbound destinations; our hosted workflow needs TLS to our telemetry endpoints for debugging (we can make this optional).

I'm available for the Tue Aug 31 10:00–11:00 slot and Wed Sep 1 14:00–15:00. Thu Sep 2 08:00 is tight for me.

I'll also add a couple bullet points to the agenda about expected ports and (optional) debug access during a smoke test.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: note-to-add-ports.txt)

- Confirm whether our egress rules need any exceptions (TBD).

Priyom — please go ahead and send the calendar invite + Zoom link and include the attached agenda and network diagram. Also mark the invite with a short pre-call checklist so our security lead can decide whether to join synchronously.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
